title: Computer Vision Engineer
description: Job Title: Computer Vision Engineer Location: Helsinki, Finland (On-Site) Type: Permanent About the role: Your core mission is to research and develop generative and 3D spatial AI that runs efficiently on-device — enabling machines to understand the real world and generate high-quality images, video, and 3D content in real time, under tight compute, memory, and power constraints. Responsibilities: - Research and develop on-device generative models for image, video, and 3D content creation and editing - Build algorithms for 3D reconstruction, depth estimation, and spatial/visual understanding - Optimize models for edge deployment: quantization, distillation, pruning, and NPU/GPU acceleration - Take ideas from prototype to shipping product, working with hardware, platform, and product teams Requirements: - PhD in Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics, or a related field - Proven ability to turn research concepts into state-of-the-art techniques that hold up against real-world complexity - Strong background in one or more of: diffusion / flow-matching / autoregressive generative models; depth estimation and 3D scene - reconstruction (NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting); 3D generative AI; multimodal LLMs and visual understanding; neural networks and transformers - Experience with efficient inference and model compression for resource-constrained hardware is a strong plus - Core programming: primary development in C++ with GLSL/HLSL compute shaders (Vulkan, OpenGL); Python, PyTorch, and CUDA for research and proof-of-concept work - Familiarity with mobile inference stacks (e.g., TensorRT, CoreML, QNN, ExecuTorch, NCNN) is a plus If this sounds of interest, please apply here or reach out to daniel@microtech-global.com
